product_family: MonkeyLearn was a standalone no-code text analytics API/SaaS (sentiment, topic, and intent classification). privacy.ai_training_note: No public vendor-domain statement was found that explicitly confirms or denies whether customer text/feedback data (including data processed by the former MonkeyLearn NLP/text-analytics engine, now 'Medallia Text Analytics') is used to train Medallia's AI/ML models, nor is there a documented opt-out. The closest statement found is a general data-handling clause: Medallia 'does not review, share, distribute or reference any Customer Data except as provided in the customer's contract, and if applicable, in the Data Processing Agreement.' This implies contractual control but is not an explicit AI-training clause; whether customer text data is used for training remains unresolved.
privacy.data_region: Not explicitly published as a self-service data-residency/region picker. Medallia states it operates 'a private cloud where we own and maintain our own hardware in Tier III colocation facilities' with single-tenant architecture, and covers EU data transfers via SCCs and Data Privacy Framework certification, but no public page enumerates selectable regions.

security.name: Infrastructure model
security.value: Private cloud, single-tenant architecture, Tier III colocation facilities, customer data segregation.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Granular role-based access, data masking, IP allowlisting.

security.name: Field-level encryption
security.value: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) field-level data encryption offered; general 'encryption in transit / at rest' language was not found on the public security or trust-center summary pages reviewed.

security.name: Secure development lifecycle
security.value: Secure software development process including design reviews, threat modeling, risk assessment, and security touchpoints at every phase of development.

security.name: Ongoing assurance
security.value: Regular internal and external audits; annual SOC 2 Type II audit with report issued to customers.

products.name: MonkeyLearn (legacy, standalone product - discontinued)
products.data_scope: Text submitted via API or web app for sentiment analysis, topic detection, and custom text classification.
products.notes: monkeylearn.com now returns a 301 permanent redirect to medallia.com. There is no live standalone MonkeyLearn signup, pricing page, or product as of 2026; it should not be treated as an active, independently operated tool.

products.name: Medallia Text Analytics (current successor)
products.category: AI text/NLP analytics module within an enterprise CX/EX platform
products.data_scope: Customer and employee feedback text ingested through the broader Medallia Experience Cloud platform.
products.notes: MonkeyLearn's NLP technology and team were absorbed into this module following the 2022 acquisition. It is sold and secured as part of Medallia Experience Cloud, not as a separate product with its own trust documentation.

products.name: Medallia Experience Cloud (parent platform)
products.data_scope: Full multi-channel experience data: surveys, digital feedback, contact-center conversations, and text/NLP analytics.
products.notes: Holds the enterprise-grade certifications listed here (SOC 2, ISO 27001 family, ISO 42001, HIPAA, HITRUST, FedRAMP, CSA STAR, PCI DSS). Text Analytics (formerly MonkeyLearn) inherits this platform-wide compliance posture rather than having its own separate audit scope.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise, quote-based (Medallia does not publish self-serve pricing). Legacy MonkeyLearn previously offered a free tier and self-serve paid plans; these are no longer available since the product was absorbed into Medallia Experience Cloud.
compare.data_residency: Not publicly enumerated as selectable regions; Medallia operates owned infrastructure in Tier III colocation facilities and covers cross-border EU transfers via SCCs and Data Privacy Framework certification.

flags: 'MonkeyLearn' is no longer an independently operating product. monkeylearn.com issues a permanent redirect to medallia.com, confirming Medallia, Inc. acquired MonkeyLearn Inc. in 2022 and folded its technology into 'Medallia Text Analytics' inside Medallia Experience Cloud.

All certifications listed (SOC 2, ISO 27001 family, ISO 42001, HIPAA, HITRUST, FedRAMP, CSA STAR, PCI DSS) are held by Medallia, Inc. / Medallia Experience Cloud as a whole platform via its SafeBase trust center. No certificate or audit is scoped specifically to the former MonkeyLearn text-analytics engine; these reflect the current legal entity's platform-wide posture, not a MonkeyLearn-specific audit.

No public statement on medallia.com explicitly confirms or denies whether customer text data is used to train Medallia's (or the legacy MonkeyLearn) NLP/AI models, and no opt-out mechanism is documented.
